storm.label: The dispel that stopped at nothing
storm.explanation: A level fifty priest stands near the west edge of a lit arena with three vampire bats to its east, full mana, and considers Dispel Undead. The LOS-dispel beam walk has no arrival break: it runs past the bats to the maximum range and exits through the excessive-distance guard, discarding everything it counted, and the launcher returns its initial minus one instead of zero. The dispel is valued at minus fifteen - the leaked minus one minus the spell cost. The correction breaks the walk at the target like a ball, takes path damage for bolts and beams only, and returns zero when nothing survived: the blast scan finally runs and values the bats at five hundred thirty-four.

control.label: Control: the holy orb ball
control.explanation: The same priest considers Orb of Draining, a ball, whose walk already breaks at its target. It is valued identically at five hundred forty before and after the correction, and the complete log is byte-identical: the fix changes only the LOS-dispel walk and the launcher leak.
